summary.text: The champion crosses into the outer warzone, binds one active save pillar, and survives the first proof that death and distance now carry strategic consequences.

chapter.progressionIntent: Gate entry occurs around the level-40 readiness target; the pillar rule is mandatory in the main quest, not a side quest.

summary.text: Cross the main gate, claim one valid save pillar through direct interaction, and establish the first secure outer-warzone route.

text.text: Cross the realm's main gate into the outer warzone.
Reach a valid save pillar without using remote or menu substitution.
Bind exactly one active respawn location.
Hold the route long enough for the first realm patrol to cross.

choice.meaning: Choose among valid nearby pillars by direct interaction; only one remains active and changing it later requires another valid pillar.

mainQuest.completionOutcome: The outer warzone becomes reachable, one active respawn pillar is committed, and the champion receives the bridge and crossroads objective map.

summary.text: Inspect abandoned pillar inscriptions and learn why remote rebinding once caused an army to respawn into a massacre.

mainStoryContribution.text: Makes the one-active-pillar rule understandable and memorable instead of an arbitrary restriction.

text.text: Post the verified warning at the active pillar.
Pillar UI provides a clearer warning before replacing the active point; no additional bind is granted.

summary.text: Carry final messages between gate defenders and the families who will not see them until the patrol returns.

mainStoryContribution.text: Gives emotional closure to the inner-realm arc and makes crossing the gate feel irreversible without making the profile choice itself irreversible.

text.text: Collect sealed messages from the departing watch.
Deliver them without altering their words.
Bring one family token back to the gate captain.
Surviving watch members and families reunite in the postgame montage.
